description: Re-check a domain every 24 hour(s) and raise an alert when its email posture (DMARC or SPF weakened, DKIM key lost, MX provider changed, score drop...) or technology stack (tool added or removed) changes. Alerts are read with get_alerts and can also be pushed to a signed webhook. Watching a domain again updates its checks and webhook. Plan keys include a number of watched domains; prepaid callers pay 1 credit(s) per scheduled check, and a watch pauses (with an alert) when the balance runs out and resumes after a top-up. Watching itself is free.

domain.description: Domain to inspect. Accepts a bare hostname ("example.com"), a URL ("https://www.example.com/pricing") or an email address ("jane@example.com"). Scheme, path, port and query are stripped; IDN names are accepted.

webhookUrl.description: Optional https URL that receives each batch of alerts as a signed POST (header x-stackdns-signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of `${t}.${body}`>). Omit to use get_alerts only.

name: watch_domain

creditsCharged.description: Prepaid credits this call itself charged: 0 for plan keys (they spend daily quota instead) and 0 for start_bulk_check, whose up-front charge is reported in job.creditsCharged and job.quotaUnitsCharged; creditsRemaining already reflects it.

webhookSecret.description: Signing secret for webhook deliveries, shown only when the watch is created. Store it now.
